title: Profile ODE2RHS of the rigid-body models: bodies, marker data, connectors, assembly
author: Claude-JG
description: Before compile-time sizes are introduced (docs/dev/design/linalgFixedSize.md), the time of ODE2RHS in the rigid-body chains and the connector models is divided among the bodies, the marker data, the connectors and the assembly, on both modules, so that the gain of fixed-size matrices at the solver level can be estimated.
releaseNotes: Profiled ODE2RHS of the rigid-body performance models: in the chain of rigid bodies with RigidBodySpringDamper the connector force takes 41 %, the marker kinematics 26 %, the bodies 19 %, the projection 9 % and the assembly 5 %; every connector of the performance models uses the connector interface (docs/dev/design/linalgFixedSize.md section 8).
